newsitem.title: FRANCE: IMF sees French 97 deficit at 3.3 pct, possibly 3.0.
newsitem.headline: IMF sees French 97 deficit at 3.3 pct, possibly 3.0.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund issued two 1997 deficit forecasts for France on Wednesday, one saying the deficit could hit 3.3 percent of gross domestic product and the other saying it could be cut to 3.0 percent.
In a table in its semi-annual World Economic Outlook report, the IMF said it was predicting a 3.3 percent deficit based on information available up to the end of March 1997.

The lower deficit forecast was included in a list for all EU countries which did not take into account further consolidation measures which EU goverments planned but had not yet announced, it said in a footnote to the table.
The Maastricht treaty requires countries to limit deficits to three percent of GDP in 1997 to join European monetary union.
